tools.description: List sibling attachment files for an entry (excludes entry.nomai). Returns {items: [{filename, size, modified}]}. Empty list if the entry has no attachments.
tools.name: attachment.list

tools.description: Read a sibling attachment file (image/PDF/...) for an entry. Returns {filename, mime, base64}. The file must already exist under the entry directory (written via entry.create/block.append/block.update `attachments`, or pre-placed).
tools.name: attachment.read

tools.description: Execute multiple mutation ops (entry.create/update/delete, link.create/delete) in a single atomic transaction. Ops may reference each other via {"$ref": "op_id"} or {"$ref": "op_id.field"}. Atomic mode only (any failure rolls back the whole batch). See docs/reference.md for full semantics.

atomic.description: parsed but currently always treated as true

params.description: method-specific params; may contain {"$ref": "op_id[.field]"} placeholders resolved against prior op results

tools.name: batch

tools.description: Append a new block (type, text, optional attrs) to an entry. Computes the next ordinal and re-renders the entry's .nomai file. Invalidates search cache. Returns the created block.

attachments.description:
`{filename: base64_string}` — decoded to bytes and written as sibling
files before the block is appended.

tools.name: block.append

tools.description: Delete a block by ULID. Re-renders the parent entry's .nomai file and invalidates the search cache. Returns {deleted: true, id}.
tools.name: block.delete

tools.description: Fetch a single block by ULID. Returns error 1001 if not found.
tools.name: block.get

tools.description: List all blocks of an entry, in ordinal order. Returns {items, total}.
tools.name: block.list

tools.description: Update a block's type, text, or attrs by ULID. At least one of type/text/attrs must be present. Re-renders the entry's .nomai file. Invalidates search cache. Returns the updated block.

attachments.description:
`{filename: base64_string}` — decoded to bytes and written as sibling
files before the block is updated.

tools.name: block.update

tools.description: Clear embedding cache and/or search cache. namespace controls which: embeddings (default), searches, or all. For embeddings, optional model/before/keep_recent filter the rows cleared.
tools.name: cache.clear

tools.description: Report embedding-cache and search-cache stats: row counts, hit rates, generation, warnings.
tools.name: cache.stats

tools.description: Fetch a single chunk by ULID. Returns error 1001 if not found.
tools.name: chunk.get

tools.description: List all chunks belonging to a block, in ordinal order. Returns {items, total}.
tools.name: chunk.list

tools.description: Append one or more turns to an existing conversation. The turns array specifies role and content for each turn. Returns the created turns with their generated ULIDs.
tools.name: conversation.append

tools.description: Create a new conversation session with optional title, tags, attrs, and initial turns. Returns the created conversation with its generated ULID and any turns.

turns.description: Optional initial turns, created atomically with the conversation

tools.name: conversation.create

tools.description: Delete a conversation by ULID. CASCADE removes its turns and FTS entries. Returns {deleted: true, id}.
tools.name: conversation.delete

tools.description: Fetch a single conversation by ULID, including all its turns in ordinal order. Returns error 1001 if not found.
tools.name: conversation.get

tools.description: List conversations with optional tag filter, pagination, and ordering. Default limit 50, offset 0, order created_desc. Returns {items, total, has_more}.

transient.description: Filter by short-term marker: true → only transient conversations, false → only long-term, omit → all.

tools.name: conversation.list

tools.description: Full-text search through conversation turn content. Returns matching turns with their parent conversation, a highlighted snippet, and relevance score. Short queries (< 3 characters) fall back to LIKE-based matching. Default limit 10.

query.description: Search query — passed directly to FTS5 MATCH for queries >= 3 characters, otherwise LIKE-based substring match

tools.name: conversation.search

tools.description: Update a conversation's metadata (title, tags, attrs) by ULID. Cannot change turns; use conversation.append for that. Returns the updated conversation.
tools.name: conversation.update

tools.description: Purge transient (short-term) entries — those created with attrs.transient=true. SAFE BY DEFAULT: returns a preview without deleting (dry_run defaults to true). Call again with dry_run=false to actually delete. Only affects transient entries; permanent entries are never touched. Use older_than_secs to limit to entries older than a threshold (e.g. 604800 for 7 days). Returns {dry_run, count, entries:[{id,title,created_at}...max50], truncated} in preview mode, or {dry_run:false, deleted, ids, failed:[{id,error}]} in real mode.

dry_run.description: If true (default), return a preview without deleting. Set false to actually delete.

older_than_secs.description: Only purge transient entries older than this many seconds. Omit = all transient entries.

tools.name: entries.purge_transient

tools.description: Create a new knowledge entry with title and content blocks. Chunks and embeddings are derived automatically. Returns the created entry with its generated ULID.

attachments.description: Sibling attachment files (image/PDF/...), keyed by filename. Values are base64-encoded bytes. Referenced by @image/@source block `src` attrs.

tools.name: entry.create

tools.description: Delete an entry by ULID. CASCADE removes its blocks and chunks; the search cache is invalidated. Returns {deleted: true, id}.
tools.name: entry.delete

tools.description: Fetch a single entry by ULID. Returns error 1001 if not found.
tools.name: entry.get

tools.description: List entries with optional tag filter, pagination, and ordering. Default limit 50, offset 0, order created_desc. Set include_blocks=true to inline block content (avoids N+1 follow-up entry.get calls). Returns {items, total, has_more}.

transient.description: Filter by short-term marker: true → only transient entries, false → only long-term, omit → all.

tools.name: entry.list

tools.description: Update an entry's metadata (title, tags, attrs, source) by ULID. Cannot change blocks; use block.* for that. Invalidates search cache. Returns the updated entry.

source.description: Set source (string) or clear it (null). Omit to leave unchanged.

tools.name: entry.update

tools.description: Fetch a single event by ULID. Returns error 1001 if not found.
tools.name: events.get

tools.description: List events matching filters, ordered by ULID (time-ordered). since is exclusive (returns id > since). Use for incremental sync: client tracks last_seen_id and pulls via since=last_seen_id. Default limit 100, order asc. Returns {items, has_more, total}.
tools.name: events.list

tools.description: Delete events with id < before (exclusive). Optional type filter (e.g. "entry.created"). For retention/cleanup. Returns {deleted: N}.
tools.name: events.purge

tools.description: Wipe every derived table and re-index every entry from the filesystem. Use to recover from index corruption; heavier than index.sync.
tools.name: index.rebuild

tools.description: Reconcile the SQLite index with the filesystem source-of-truth. Walks every entry's .nomai file, diffing mtime; adds/updates/removes rows as needed. Returns per-bucket counts.
tools.name: index.sync

tools.description: Read-only drift report between the filesystem and the SQLite index. Same scan as index.sync but never mutates; use to preview drift before deciding to sync or rebuild.
tools.name: index.verify

tools.description: Create a directed, typed link between two entries (e.g. references, supports, contradicts). Returns the created link.
tools.name: link.create

tools.description: Delete a link by ULID. Returns {deleted: true}.
tools.name: link.delete

tools.description: Fetch a single link by ULID. Returns error 1001 if not found.
tools.name: link.get

tools.description: List links matching filters. At least one of from/to/relation must be supplied (listing all links is rejected). Default limit 50, offset 0. Returns {items, total}.
tools.name: link.list

tools.description: List entries neighboring the given id via links. direction: out (id is source), in (id is target), or both (default). Returns {entries, links}.
tools.name: link.neighbors

tools.description: List the currently configured embedding and LLM providers with their model names.
tools.name: provider.list

tools.description: Rerank candidate documents against a query using the configured reranker. Candidates are scored for relevance and returned sorted best-first. Use after search to refine results, or independently with any document set.

RerankCandidateWire.description:
Wire-level candidate (mirrors providers::RerankCandidate but with
schemars JsonSchema derive — the providers type is intentionally
schema-free because it's a trait-level type).

tools.name: rerank.rerank

tools.description: Record positive feedback for results returned by a prior search. Idempotent per search and entry; returns applied reinforcement records and entries already applied by a retry.
tools.name: search.feedback

tools.description: Fulltext search over block text via SQLite FTS5. Returns entries ranked by relevance. Score is relative relevance (not a boolean hit marker): higher means stronger match; near-zero means weak match. Optional `tag` restricts results to entries whose `tags` array contains that value. Each call is cached per (query, limit, block_type, tag).

block_type.description:
Optional block-type filter (e.g. `"claim"`, `"note"`). When supplied,
restricts matches to blocks of that type.

rewrite.description:
Optional query rewriting strategy. Currently only `"expand"` is
supported — resolves pronouns and expands abbreviations using
the configured LLM. Omit to skip rewriting.

rewrite_context.description:
Conversation context for query rewriting. Helps the LLM resolve
pronouns and implicit references. Only used when `rewrite` is set.

tag.description:
Optional tag filter: restricts matches to entries whose `tags` JSON
array contains this exact value (same semantics as `entry.list`'s
`tag`). Whitespace-only / empty values are treated as no filter.

tools.name: search.fulltext

tools.description: Hybrid search fusing fulltext (FTS5 BM25) and semantic (cosine similarity) results via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (k=60). Returns entry-granularity results with per-retriever scores and ranks. Optional weights bias the fusion toward one retriever. Cached per (query, limit, block_type, tag, weights).

rewrite.description:
Optional query rewriting strategy. Currently only `"expand"` is
supported — resolves pronouns and expands abbreviations using
the configured LLM. Omit to skip rewriting.

rewrite_context.description:
Conversation context for query rewriting. Helps the LLM resolve
pronouns and implicit references. Only used when `rewrite` is set.

tools.name: search.hybrid

tools.description: Semantic search over chunk embeddings via sqlite-vec cosine similarity. Queries the embedding provider on each unique query (cached). Returns chunks ranked by similarity. Optional `tag` restricts results to entries whose `tags` array contains that value.

block_type.description: Optional block-type filter applied via JOIN blocks.

rewrite.description:
Optional query rewriting strategy. Currently only `"expand"` is
supported — resolves pronouns and expands abbreviations using
the configured LLM. Omit to skip rewriting.

rewrite_context.description:
Conversation context for query rewriting. Helps the LLM resolve
pronouns and implicit references. Only used when `rewrite` is set.

tag.description:
Optional tag filter: restricts matches to entries whose `tags` JSON
array contains this exact value (same semantics as `entry.list`'s
`tag`). Whitespace-only / empty values are treated as no filter.

tools.name: search.semantic

tools.description: Initialize the knowledge_root as a git repository for multi-device sync. Configures the remote, writes .gitignore + .gitattributes (LFS rules), runs git lfs install, and makes an initial commit. Idempotent — rejects if .git already exists.
tools.name: sync.init

tools.description: Sync the knowledge_root with its git remote: commit local changes, pull --rebase, push, then rebuild the local SQLite index via index.sync. On rebase conflict, returns the conflicted files and leaves the repo mid-rebase; resolve in an editor and re-run to continue.
tools.name: sync.run

tools.description: Walk every entry row and render a .nomai file for any that lack one. Skips entries that already have a .nomai on disk. Returns {exported, skipped, errors}.
tools.name: system.export_to_fs

tools.description: Rebuild the resident daemon's internal state (sqlite/embedder/llm/cache) in-process without dropping client connections. Use when embedding calls (search.semantic / ingest) start failing due to long-uptime state decay. Returns {ok: true}. No params.
tools.name: system.restart
